verdict.rationale: Phaser ships an official, well-documented SDK: npm package with semantic versioning, CLI installer, jsDelivr CDN, TypeScript type definitions, and GitHub repo, and this is corroborated by numerous independent developers who report building shipped games directly against it. Community feedback also notes real limitations (TS support historically 'best-effort' via DefinitelyTyped rather than natively authored) and documentation quality complaints, which slightly temper otherwise clear delivery. Missing for 10: stronger independent verification of first-party (vs DefinitelyTyped) TypeScript authoring and no formal SDK versioning/release-notes evidence.
